text: Grab MERSCOPE codebook. Must row names first column giving species names. text . Get summary stats Now make summary stats, mouse Now try new function.
code: file_path <- system.file(   "extdata",   "codebook_obs.csv",   package = "flipFISH" ) codebook <- read.csv(file_path, row.names = 1) max_correctable_Hamming_distance <- 3 data_path_cells <- "/Users/michaelbarkasi/projects_Oviedo_lab/_molecular_mechanisms_of_ACx_lateralization/data_ACx_cells" count_data <- wispack::make_count_data(   data_path = data_path_cells,    remove_L1 = FALSE,    ROI_only = FALSE,   raw = TRUE,   drop_blanks = FALSE,   verbose = TRUE ) count_data <- count_data$count_data # Extract summary statistics (mean, variance, summed counts) from data # ...  it will return a list holding two data.frames formatted like those imported below from the csv files summary_stats_from_data <- function(     obs_data         # data frame, columns as barcodes (genes or blanks), rows as cells, elements as spot counts   ) {          # Extract summary statistics     observed_rates         <- colMeans(obs_data)     observed_variance      <- rep(NA, length(observed_rates))     for (i in 1:length(observed_variance)) {       observed_variance[i] <- sd(obs_data[,i])^2     }     observed_counts        <- colSums(obs_data)          # Collect summary stats     data <- data.frame(       rates    = observed_rates,       variance = observed_variance,       counts   = observed_counts     )     rownames(data) <- colnames(obs_data)          return(data)        }  mice <- unique(count_data$mouse) mice_masks <- lapply(mice, function(m) count_data$mouse == m) count_data <- count_data[,13:(ncol(count_data)-6)] summary_stats_data <- data.frame(mouse = c(), rates = c(), variance = c(), counts = c()) for (i in seq_along(mice_masks)) {   ss <- summary_stats_from_data(count_data[mice_masks[[i]],])   ss <- cbind(mouse = i, ss)   summary_stats_data <- rbind(summary_stats_data, ss) } write.csv(   summary_stats_data,   file = "/Users/michaelbarkasi/projects_Oviedo_lab/R_packages/flipFISH/inst/extdata/summary_stats_all_mice.csv",   row.names = TRUE ) file_path <- system.file(   "extdata",   "summary_stats_all_mice.csv",   package = "flipFISH" ) summary_stats_data <- read.csv(file_path, row.names = 1)  m1_summary_stats <- summary_stats_data[summary_stats_data$mouse == 1,] rownames(codebook) <- gsub("-", ".", rownames(codebook))

text: mQC_msle(params, data_ptr) computes following pipeline: Parameter layout (packed pack_fr): | Index range | Parameter | |————————————|————————-| | [0, N_bits) | rate10[] (P(1→0)) | | [N_bits, 2*N_bits) | rate01[] (P(0→1)) | | [2*N_bits, 2*N_bits+corr_free) | corr1[k] (k = *(-1)/2+j) | | [2*N_bits+corr_free, end) | corr0[k] |

what: TR gradient (inner layer — the core derivation)
title: Plan: Analytical Gradient of mQC_msle for nlopt
text: TR(bc, flips, fr) computes: TR = \prod_i f_i, \quad   f_i = \begin{cases} p_i & \text{} \text{flip}_i = 1 \\ 1 - p_i & \text{} \text{flip}_i = 0 \end{cases} correlation-adjusted flip probability bit : p_i = \exp\!\bigl(\underbrace{\log\text{rate\_flip}_i}_{\text{log\_rate10}[] \text{ } \text{log\_rate01}[]} - \underbrace{\sum_{j < ,\, \text{cond}(,j)} \log(1 - \text{corr}_{ij})}_{\text{log\_inv\_corr}[]}\bigr) condition cond(,j) : - use corr1[k] bit_i = 1 flip_j = 1 - use corr0[k] bit_i = 0 flip_j = 1 Since log TR = Σ_i log f_i, gradient decomposes bit--bit. Define sensitivity factor bit : \delta_i \;=\; \frac{\partial \log TR}{\partial \log p_i}   = \begin{cases} 1 & \text{} \text{flip}_i = 1 \\ -p_i/(1-p_i) & \text{} \text{flip}_i = 0 \end{cases} : \partial TR / \partial \theta = TR \cdot \partial \log TR / \partial \theta.
